Browsing this website

The application creates no advertising profile and does not individually measure your browsing. Loading a page necessarily sends technical information to the hosting provider: IP address, request time, requested resource and browser information. This information may be used to deliver the website, secure it and diagnose errors.

Delivery and security of the website rely on the legitimate interest in operating a reliable online service. Technical information is available to the hosting providers within the scope of their services and contractual obligations.

Preparing an enquiry

The form prepares an email draft in your browser. No form field or draft is sent to the website server, recorded in a database or stored in the privacy preference. You control sending through your own email application. Any saved copy then depends on your email application’s settings.

The draft may contain your contact details and the travel information you choose to provide. Fields marked required are needed to prepare it. Other fields are optional. Do not include passport numbers, bank details or medical information in this form.

If you send the message, Héline First receives it to respond to your enquiry and, where relevant, prepare a service at your request. This purpose relies on pre-contractual steps you request. Receiving an enquiry does not authorize advertising emails or newsletter subscription.

Recipients and retention

Sent messages are addressed to Héline First and the email providers needed to receive them. The web application retains no form message. A saved notice acknowledgement remains only on your device for 180 days.

Retention periods for received emails and service files still need to be specified by Héline First. Contact the company for that information before sending sensitive details.

Hosting and international transfers

The public website is hosted by Render Services, Inc., 525 Brannan Street, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. +1 415 319 8186. Render privacy policy.

Render states that its services involve processing in the United States and, depending on the service, other countries. Its documents describe available transfer mechanisms, including standard contractual clauses and the Data Privacy Framework. The publisher must verify the contractual arrangements and configuration actually used.

Render data processing addendum. Private previews on chatgpt.site are provided by OpenAI and may be subject to its own access and privacy rules. Preview-provider privacy policy.

Your rights

Subject to the conditions in the GDPR, you may request access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability of your data, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. Consent may be withdrawn where processing relies on it.

To exercise your rights, contact contact@helinefirst.com. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL.

External links and updates

External websites and your email application have their own privacy practices. This notice will be updated if the form, hosting or browser-storage use changes.
